hints: Colour the start vertex 0, then every neighbour gets 1 - colour[u]. That single expression flips 0 and 1.
Use colour[v] == -1 as the visited test - one array does both jobs.
Check for a conflict when the neighbour is ALREADY coloured: if it has the same colour as the current vertex, an edge joins two vertices on the same side and the graph is not bipartite.
source: Core of the DSA Lab Week 3 evaluation question
title: Bipartite check by 2-colouring
